name: rift-ds
description: An AI-ready React design system: accessible components on composable tokens, light/dark theming, and CSS-variable overrides.
$comment-overrides: Pins that outrank the ranges next declares for two of its transitive deps: postcss (next pins an exact 8.5.x, 8.5.23 as of next 16.3.4, and the override takes the patched newer 8.5 line) and sharp (next's optional image optimiser; the root devDependency copy exists only so the whole tree dedupes onto one pinned build of it, no repo code imports sharp directly). Both now sit outside next's own ranges, so `npm ls` reports them invalid and exits non-zero by design; `npm audit` is the real test, and the pins can retire when next's declared ranges catch up. npm ONLY honours overrides in the workspace ROOT, the copies that used to live in website/package.json were silently ignored after the workspaces conversion, which un-pinned both. Keep them here.
